items.headline: Heat Advisory issued September 4 at 4:46AM AKDT until September 4 at 7:00PM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Temperatures up to 80 expected.

* WHERE...Prince of Wales Island.

* WHEN...From noon today to 7 PM AKDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...Individuals not accustomed to these unusually hot
temperatures for this region may experience heat related illnesses.
items.instruction:
Drink plenty of fluids, and check up on elderly and vulnerable
relatives and neighbors.

Close curtains during the daytime to reduce sun insulation into the
home and open windows at night to allow the home to cool off. Utilize
fans or community buildings with air conditioning.

items.description:

peak at 1 foot or less above the normal highest tide line, similar

flooding is expected. The timing of highest water will be between
5am and 8am each morning. The most likely communities to
experience these elevated water levels include Kipnuk,

items.description:
